Student Property · 4 Bedroom House · Great Location

My Property Box are delighted to offer for rent this spacious and well presented 4 bed student property. Benefiting from wooden floors, large living room, separate dining room, all double bedrooms and large garage. Located close to West Jesmond Metro and Sainsbury's and a short walk to the bars on Osborne Road. To arrange your viewing call the My Property Box and speak to the lettings team 0191 212 0400.
